scope: C# Phase 4 performance pass: complete active semantic corpus, every checker-location API family, safety suites, type-state/algebra differential suites, and node-builder tracking/flag suites.
changes: Reuse binder container metadata for ambient module discovery.
Remove temporary ancestry lists and repeated read-only wrappers.
Build immutable type-cache key arrays once and hash instantiation keys once.
Group diagnostic snapshots once for bulk requests without retaining a cache across requests.
Compact sorted diagnostics in place and allocate traversal stacks only for nested comparisons.
Discard relation diagnostics at the reference type-serialization recursion limit; preserve mapped-property undefined when the original declaration is required.
